currentStep: Fixed 6 perf regressions: MAP_COLS image_urls, conditional useSurveyById, keepPreviousData restored, removed duplicate MapMarkerCount query, removed 100ms setInterval timers, guarded mapMarkers sync cascade
keyDecisions: MAP_COLS keeps image_urls — portal images show immediately in delivery sheet and HDS; old 9s bottleneck was cross-table join (eliminated by is_paid column), not column size
useSurveyById is conditional (skipped when houseListSurvey exists) — eliminates extra API call per HDS navigation
keepPreviousData restored on useSurveyById — prevents flicker/double-render during rare fallback fetch
survey = houseListSurvey || apiSurvey — houseListSurvey priority gives immediate correct data including image_urls and psid
MapMarkerCount reads from store mapMarkers instead of duplicate useSurveyData — eliminates one full survey fetch per map load
Replaced 100ms setInterval live timers with static '...' display — no more 10 re-renders/second during loading
mapMarkers sync effect only closes HDS on filter-out — no unnecessary selectHouse calls on data refresh
HDS compound endpoint created (5 sub-queries → 1 request), 5 unused service files marked dead
Migration 045 (is_paid + 6 indexes) applied — payment filter uses single .eq('is_paid', true/false) instead of 2-phase chunked join
Migration 046 (get_orphan_psids RPC) applied — replaces client-side Set intersection on 212K rows
Migration 047 (uc_name + uc_status indexes) applied — map query uses Bitmap Index Scan (0.6ms) instead of seq scan (4+s)
